Directions: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the correct option which is different from the given set.

202 - 40, 305 - 150, 120 - 0

In a row of students, Reeta is 11th from the right and Madhuri is 14th from the left. Riya is exactly in the middle of Reeta and Madhuri. If there are 16 students in the row, what is Riya's position from the left?
questions.solution:
The total number of students in the row is 16.

Reeta's position = 11th from the right of the row.

so, Reeta's position = **(16 - 11) + 1 i.e. 6th** from the left of the row.

**Given,** Madhuri is **14****th** from the left.

**So, there have 7 students between Reeta and Madhuri.**

As Riya is exactly in the middle of Reeta and Madhuri. 

The diagram will follow:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbbb9ae9692d7eaa1df71f220ec959f8814666377e2b786e3f5a2ca163e151fa.png] 

Therefore, the position of Riya from the left 

=** Reeta's position from left + 4**

**= 6 + 4 **

**= 10th.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"10th".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements:

Some bananas are litchis.

All litchis are kiwis.

Some kiwis are strawberries.

Conclusions:

1. All bananas are kiwis is a possibility.

2. All kiwis are litchis.
questions.solution:
Lease possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fbcef0d7ab1280ceba6edb04cdbfc4e8a83bfafadc44f73f9fab4ebd47994b7.png] 

**Conclusions:****
 1. All bananas are kiwis is a possibility → **Follow **(Some bananas are litchis and all litchis are kiwis. so, All bananas are kiwis is a possibility but not definite)

2. All kiwis are litchis → **Does not follow** (All litchis are kiwis. so, all kiwis are litchis is possible but not definite).

Only conclusion 1 follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 1**”.

questions.question: Ganpat starts from point A and walks 18 m west. He turns left, walks 32 m, then turns left again, walks 26 m, then turns left again, walks 61 m, and stops at point B. Meena starts from point Z, which is 22 m east of point A. She walks 42 m north, turns right, walks 35 m, turns right and walks 13 m, and stops at point Y. Find the shortest distance between point B and point Y. (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa20de098de0df50eccdebc19f023b7b549b66a238f9b4a0b1f816668aed3b7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19019b5e3ea63a4862d4fa78a9d6dd6ec42ad5a2f4720b456704a55a6a1f1678.png] 

Shortest distance between B and Y = ((18 + 22) - 26) + 35

⟹ (40 - 26 ) + 35

⟹ 14 + 35

⟹ 49 m

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.

questions.question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people in each row, in such a way that there is an equal distance between adjacent persons. Row 1 contains A, B, C and D, all of whom are facing south. Row 2 contains P, Q, R and S, all of whom are facing north. Thus, each person faces another person in the other row. Only two people sit between P and Q. A faces the person sitting to the immediate left of P. R sits to the immediate left of S. D sits to the immediate right of C. Who among the following faces P?
questions.solution:
Row 1 contains A, B, C and D, all of whom are facing south. Row 2 contains P, Q, R and S, all of whom are facing north. 

1. Only two people sit between P and Q.

2. R sits to the immediate left of S. 

3. A faces the person sitting to the immediate left of P.

4. D sits to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b79647de2a1b7e33a37c44af804dde27482c19a2540d3fc5a81e9de06b6ba413.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d653fd5c4fc2cfd6632313a3707d4126c81704a9a4e441cec310cf1d2f7f8d00.png] 

B faces P.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
